description: Navigate to the 'example-repo-local' repository in the Artifacts browser. Locate the artifact 'commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar' (path: org/apache/commons/commons-lang3/3.14.0/commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar). Find the 'Dependency Declaration' section for this artifact, copy the Maven XML snippet, and save it to a new file at '/home/ga/Desktop/maven_snippet.xml'.
